_readme: Bambu Studio settings for the boot in TPU 90A, applied by make_3mf.py over a1_project_settings.config (the user's A1 project settings from the scope lock, 0.20mm Standard @BBL A1). Filament 1 becomes the system preset named in FILAMENT_PRESET, read from the Bambu Studio install, then 'filament' below on top. Keys starting with '_' are notes. Values are written as Bambu Studio stores them (strings; lists for per-extruder keys).

print._note: Process settings. TPU 90A is fed from the external spool and limited to 2.8 mm3/s by its preset (about 33 mm/s at 0.2 x 0.42), so the speeds sit just under that and the slicer's limit rarely kicks in; slow, even extrusion is what keeps soft TPU from buckling in the extruder.
print._wall_loops: 5 x 0.42 fills the 2 mm side wall with perimeters only: no infill in the part that stretches over the bottle
print._sparse_infill_density: Solid floor (2026-11-06): with clear TPU, sparse infill shows through the wall as a cross-hatch. Back to 20% gyroid for a lighter, quicker print
print._sparse_infill_pattern: Bambu Studio refuses gyroid at 100%. Gyroid at 20%: no crossing lines, springy
print._reduce_crossing_wall: Travel round inside the walls instead of across them: TPU strings

filament._note: Filament 1, on top of the TPU 90A preset.
filament._nozzle_temperature: Preset 225; 5 degrees cooler oozes less. First layer stays at the preset's 225 to stick
filament._filament_retraction_length: Preset 0.4 strung badly on the first print (2026-11-06, timelapse on, spool maybe damp)
filament._filament_retraction_speed: Slow retraction; fast or long ones buckle soft TPU
filament._filament_z_hop: No Z hop: less oozing on travel
